bibliographic.author: Cleril
bibliographic.description:
This Interactive Fiction contains descriptions of nudity, sexual themes, violence, and is generally meant for mature audiences. Reader discretion is advised.

Welcome to the Human Interview project, volunteer #1! You've been accepted to take part in shaping the future of humanity. If you are not yet aware: Birth rates are nonexistent. Food is scarce. Resources are running out. We need to continue our legacy. We need a successor species. Something better than us.

Please read over our protocols. They're designed for us to ensure we have created the perfect subject for our future. Failure to follow protocol may result in unfortunate events.

Thank you for saving humanity.

If you want to support my work, follow me on Patreon, even for free: https://www.patreon.com/c/Cleril

I love knowing someone enjoys what I create.
